name: Warsaw Zen Center: Wu Bong Sa
reason: Refused: zen.pl (robots.txt * group allows us) answered 429 on its fourth request (/godziny-praktyki/), after the home page, a sitemap and the temple page, so I fetched nothing more from it and did not retry. The pages read had no published email or contact form, and no schedule, events or prices, so a plan would fail the contact rule. Read before the refusal: Wu Bong Sa in Falenica, Warsaw, is the main temple of the Kwan Um School in Poland, active for over 40 years, and is raising money for urgent repairs.
